answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The grove register is checked at draw time, pulse lists the eligible set, and lotus seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 16 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
